prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: individual blog cover for A2Z Skills. Contemporary flat gouache and cut-paper editorial illustration; crisp dark navy outlines; subtle paper grain; gently rounded friendly recognisable objects; sophisticated not childish; warm ivory background, cobalt blue with muted coral-orange, sage green and pale sky-blue; strong single focal metaphor; wide landscape 3:2; no text, lettering, logos, people, screenshots, fake errors, numerical data, watermarks or decorative sparkles. Subject: Two parallel webhook paths connect a friendly laptop to workflow nodes: a short coral test path ends in a one-shot open socket, and a longer cobalt production path leads to a server with a clear on/off toggle shape. A single envelope waits between the routes. Conceptual, not a factual technical diagram. A single polished original image for this article, not a collage of multiple covers. Keep all important objects inside the middle 80% for responsive cropping. The image should feel like part of one publication's illustration family.
